The chart uses external labels with leader lines to emphasize three main groupings of slices: 'one style' (32.5%), 'two styles' (51.1%), and 'three styles' (16.4%). This is a form of visual emphasis that the description fails to mention and explicitly denies.
The description does not mention that the chart is a donut chart, not a standard pie chart.
